name: Standing Calf Raise
summary: An isolation lift for the calf muscles performed standing, with the knees nearly straight, which loads the gastrocnemius in particular.
setup: Set the shoulder pads so you can stand upright with the balls of your feet on the platform and heels hanging off.
Position your feet about hip width apart with toes pointing forward.
Keep your knees nearly straight, but not locked, and brace your trunk.
execution: Lower your heels as far as you comfortably can to get a full stretch in your calves.
Rise as high as possible onto the balls of your feet, squeezing your calves at the top.
Hold the top for a second, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom: pause and use a controlled tempo.
Cutting the range short: go to a full stretch and a full squeeze.
Bending the knees to cheat: keep them almost straight.
Rolling the ankles outward or inward: press through the ball of the big toe and keep the foot straight.
